QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Romeo Proposes
QuestInfo.0: Romeo is an alchemist in Magatia that's currently dating Juliet like there's no tomorrow. He has finally decided to pop the question to Juliet. I better go visit #bRomeo#k.
QuestInfo.1: Romeo told me although he may not be perfect, he's sure that Juliet will understand and take him regardless, and that's how he came to conclusion to propose to her. He then asked me to find a perfect engagement ring for her. The ring can be purchased at #bWedding Village#k through #bAllegro#k.\n\n#i4031806##t4031806# #b#c4031806##k/1
QuestInfo.2: I got the engagement ring and gave it to Romeo. Now, all he has to do is come up to her and propose successfully. They may be an odd couple, but they do fit like a glove. Hopefully their love will come to fruition.

0.0: (Breathing in and out heavily) Excuse me, traveler... I have just made the most important decision of my life. I... decided to... pro...propose to Ju...Juliet. What? You think it's too fast? Well... yeah, it might be... but I still want to go through with it.
0.1: I may not have a lot with me, but I am sure that Juliet will understand all that. We don't have to get married right away; I just want us to be engaged so I can tell the whole world how much I love and trust her.
0.2: As someone that has witnessed our love grow firsthand, surely you'll understand how I feel towards her right now... right?

yes.0: Then... can I ask you for... one more favor? I heard that at #bWedding Village#k, there's someone who's considered the master at making rings. I want you to go there and get the ring for us.
yes.1: I can't make this request to anyone else but you, the one person that has cheered us on from the get go. I trust that you'll help us out once more.

1.0: Ah... so this is the ring. Thank you so much, traveler. It's all thanks to you that our love has grown exponentially over the period of time. Thank you so much.
1.1: Now... all I need to do is to actually pop the question to Juliet. I don't know how she'll react to it, but... regardless of the answer, I want to make sure that you won't be disappointed by the way I conduct myself during the whole ordeal.

item.0: I don't think you were able to get the ring yet. #bAllegro#k at the #bWedding Village#k makes engagement rings that are unlike any other, so please go see him right now.
